notes: iPhone 15 Plus (A16), PocketRoofline app 1.0 (1), iOS 27.0.1 (24A446); raw capture kept unmodified in results/captures/. Matrix v1 back-to-back SISO -> LISO -> SILO, one unrecorded warmup, 3 s pause before each repeat. COLD START (thermalState nominal at the first repeat), airplane mode, unplugged, Low Power Mode off, battery 65% -> 60%. SCREEN LIVE: the app redrew a live decode chart during every repeat (the capture predates the uiDuringRepeats field). SILO STEP: decode 57.12 t/s in the last LISO repeat, 42.01 in the first SILO repeat (nominal -> fair), then 24.94-25.78 t/s at fair; iOS never reported serious. The step also appears in the 2026-10-05 (24A437) and the still-screen 2026-11-08 sessions; its cause is unexplained (README), so no peak-to-sustained percentage is quoted for this phone and its SILO figures are not a sustained-throughput estimate. Repeats whose thermal state changed mid-run are flagged per METHODOLOGY 5. The Headroom bandwidth ceiling for this phone was probed on 24A437, not this build.
